title: LucrumTech — Product teams that own the outcome
description: LucrumTech takes a product from idea to revenue — strategy, architecture, engineering, and one person accountable for whether it works.

hero.h1: Product teams that own the outcome.
hero.lede: LucrumTech takes a product from idea to revenue — strategy, architecture, engineering, and one person accountable for whether it works.
hero.sub: Distributed across the EU and Canada. One accountable team, idea to revenue.

panel.h3: Some transitions a team can't run on its own.
panel.body: Interim leadership — product, delivery, organisation, people. Two-week diagnostic, fixed fee, then you decide.

problem.h2: Most technology projects don't fail on the idea.
problem.body: Outsourcing vendors deliver code. Nobody owns whether the product works, whether the architecture survives scale, or whether anyone wants it. You end up managing the vendor instead of building the business.
problem.strong: Product ownership is the missing role. That's the role we take.

how.h2: Two weeks in, you'll know if we're right.

steps.body: We go through what you have and tell you honestly what we'd do. If it isn't worth building, we say so.
Product definition, architecture, roadmap. You own every document, whether or not you continue with us.
Senior engineers, shipping. One person accountable throughout.

how.note: Two ways to work: leadership advisory billed hourly, or a fixed-price package covering audit, strategy and execution over three to six months — delivery team included. We'll tell you which one your situation needs.

proof.h2: Six products shipped. We support every one.

cases.name: InHelper
cases.body: Case processing ran on manual document handling and took days. We built an AI platform that parses claim PDFs, transcribes calls, extracts structured data and generates the reports. Processing dropped from days to hours.

cases.name: AMOS
cases.body: Every automation changeover was slow and expensive, so nobody experimented. We built an operating layer over a cloud IoT backbone that deploys and monitors automation workflows on live machines remotely.

proof.aiLine: Two of the six are AI platforms, both in production.

team.h2: Product ownership isn't a company. It's a person.

people.name: Alex Zholtkevych
people.bio: 20+ years across Big Tech, Telecom, AdTech, FinTech, Insurance and HealthTech. MSc Computer Science. 25+ products shipped, from architecture through delivery.

people.name: Alina Ihnatenko
people.bio: Chief People Officer. 15+ years, 11+ in technology. 350+ people across organisations built and scaled, and end-to-end rebuilds delivered in three months.

people.name: Veronika Frontova
people.bio: Full-cycle recruiting across technical and non-technical roles, from sourcing through onboarding and the first 90 days. Canada, Ukraine and the EU.

team.note: Behind them: a delivery team of six engineers across the EU and Canada — full-stack, cloud, industrial systems. Built and trained by us, led by us, accountable to us.

own.h2: The product you need built. The delivery that stalled. The organisation that can't keep up.
own.lede: Same answer every time: one accountable team, in the room, until it works.
own.orgBefore: If the organisation itself is the constraint — structure, leadership, ownership — that's
own.orgLink: the other half of what we do
